item.title: Israeli triple-tap strike kills three paramedics in Lebanon, officials say
item.summary: Lebanon's government condemns as a "flagrant crime" the killing of the paramedics, one of whom featured in a BBC report.

item.title: US war on Iran was a 'mistake', says Reeves
item.summary: The chancellor's criticism follows a report that the conflict will hit the UK harder than other big economies.

item.title: Frank Gardner: What is China's role in the Iran war?
item.summary: BBC Security Correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the world's second-largest economy fits into the Gulf conflict.

item.title: Starmer says he is 'not going to yield' to pressure from Trump on Iran war
item.summary: It follows a warning from the US president that America's trade deal with the UK "can always be changed".

item.title: Man arrested climbing into Israeli embassy had arrived on small boat twice, court hears
item.summary: Abdullah Albadri denies charges preparing terrorist acts and being in possession of two knives.

item.title: Two officers charged after pregnant woman killed in crash with police car
item.summary: The woman and her unborn child died in a crash with a police car in Kidbrooke, south-east London.

item.title: Arrests after attempted arson attack on synagogue
item.summary: Police arrest a man, 46, and a woman, 47, on suspicion of arson at Finchley Reform Synagogue.

item.title: Tracking the ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Since the start of the US blockade on Monday, 15 vessels have crossed the Strait of Hormuz, nine of which have links to Iran, BBC Verify analysis of ship-tracking data suggests.

item.title: Is the US blockade of Iran working?
item.summary: BBC Verify has been looking into whether the US blockade of Iran near the Strait of Hormuz is working.

item.title: Jessie Ware on the 'hyper-surreal' high of her first arena tour
item.summary: The singer will play three UK arenas later this year, 14 years after her first album came out.
